stories.title: Generate JPK Compliance Scorecard with Traffic-Light Indicators
stories.description: Create an interactive HTML scorecard that validates 15+ NOSS requirements across all 20 CoCu files and displays pass/fail status with color-coded indicators (green=pass, yellow=warning, red=fail). This enables quick visual assessment of JPK submission readiness.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_jkp_scorecard.py reads all content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md files and validates: bilingual headers, contact hours totals, 30/70 K/P split, assessment criteria presence, learning outcome formatting, required sections (Key Terms, Common Faults, References)
Generates output/NOSS-JPK-Scorecard.html with interactive checkboxes for each NOSS requirement per CoCu unit; page includes compliance summary (e.g., '19/20 CoCu compliant, 95% overall readiness')
Exit code 0 if all 20 CoCu pass all checks; exit code 1 if any failure; includes CSV export of detailed results to output/jkp-checklist.csv

stories.title: Validate Bilingual Learning Outcomes for Semantic Equivalence
stories.description: Use NLP (sentence-transformers) to compare English and Bahasa Malaysia learning outcome descriptions. Flag pairs with semantic similarity <0.85 to catch translation quality issues before JPK submission.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_bilingual_outcomes.py parses all 20 CoCu files, extracts English/Bahasa Malaysia outcome pairs from learning outcome matrices, calculates cosine similarity using sentence-transformers model 'sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-mpnet-base-v2'

Generates output/bilingual-mismatch-report.json with entries {file: 'IT-020-3/01_...md', outcome_id: '1.1', similarity: 0.78, english: '...', malay: '...', recommendation: 'Review translation'} for all pairs <0.85
CLI flag --auto-fix generates output/bilingual-fixes-suggested.json with proposed corrections; exit code 1 if >5% of outcomes below threshold, 0 if compliant

stories.title: Audit Hardware/Software Specifications Against 2025 Vendor EOL Database
stories.description: Cross-reference all equipment and software specifications mentioned in CoCu files against 2025 end-of-life (EOL) dates from vendor databases (Intel, AMD, Microsoft, etc.). Flag any technology beyond EOL to ensure currency for JPK approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/audit_equipment_eol.py extracts hardware/software refs from content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*/Key Terms sections and Equipment lists, queries EOL database (CSV: vendor, product, version, eol_date) in scripts/data/eol-database-2025.csv

Generates output/equipment-eol-report.csv with columns (CoCu, Component, Version, EOL_Date, Days_Until_EOL, Risk_Level: green/yellow/red). Flags all items with eol_date < 2027-12-31 as yellow; < 2026-12-31 as red
Exit code 0 if no red-flag items, 1 if any; includes remediation suggestions (e.g., 'upgrade to Windows 11 (EOL 2027)') in report

stories.title: Auto-Classify Learning Outcomes by Bloom's Taxonomy Level (2023 Revision)
stories.description: Use NLP to automatically classify each learning outcome into Bloom's 2023 levels (Remember/Understand/Apply/Analyze/Evaluate/Create). Enforce minimum 20% Create-level outcomes to ensure cognitive depth meets NOSS standards.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/classify_blooms_outcomes.py parses all learning outcome matrices, sends each outcome to NLP classifier, assigns level with confidence score; output JSON maps outcome_text → {level: 'Create', confidence: 0.92}

Generates output/blooms-classification.json with per-CoCu summary {file: 'IT-020-3/01_...md', create_percentage: 18.5%, recommend_revision: 'Add 2 Create-level outcomes'}. Fails (exit code 1) if any CoCu <20% Create-level; succeeds (exit code 0) if all ≥20%

Includes --suggest-rewrites flag to generate output/blooms-rewrite-suggestions.json with proposed outcome rewrites that elevate lower levels to Create (e.g., 'Analyze network protocols → Design a network security solution')

stories.title: Validate Knowledge/Performance Split (30%/70%) Per Competency Unit
stories.description: Verify that contact hours allocation across all competencies maintains the required 30% Knowledge / 70% Performance split. Generate remediation templates for any units out of balance.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_kp_split.py reads all 20 CoCu files, parses contact hour distribution tables (Activity column, Knowledge %, Performance %), calculates weighted hours per unit; validates each unit's Knowledge hours ≥ 30% ± 2 (tolerance for rounding)

Generates output/kp-allocation-report.json with per-CoCu details {file, unit, knowledge_hours, knowledge_percent, performance_hours, performance_percent, status: 'compliant'|'needs_adjustment', suggested_fix: {rebalance_hours: 10, activity: '...'}}; exit code 0 if all compliant, 1 if out of range
Includes Excel template output/kp-remediation-templates.xlsx with hour adjustment suggestions per unit and automated formula to calculate required hour shifts

stories.title: Generate 40-50 Bilingual Assessment Question Bank Per CoCu
stories.description: Automatically generate 40-50 multiple-choice assessment items per CoCu (English + Bahasa Malaysia) aligned to learning outcomes. Maintain semantic equivalence across languages and validate question quality.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_assessment_items.py reads each CoCu file, uses LLM prompt to generate 40-50 multiple-choice questions (4 options, 1 correct answer) per outcome; ensures Bloom's level distribution matches outcome classification; validates 4 distinct plausible options per question

Generates output/assessment-items-bank.xlsx with sheets per-CoCu, columns (Outcome_ID, English_Question, Bahasa_Malaysia_Question, Option_A_EN, Option_A_MY, ..., Correct_Answer, Bloom_Level, Difficulty_Index); validates semantic equivalence >0.80 via sentence-transformers
Exit code 0 if all items pass quality validation; generates output/assessment-quality-report.json with per-question difficulty estimate and flagged anomalies requiring manual review

stories.title: Validate Competency Progression Chains (L3→L4→L5) for Orphaned Outcomes
stories.description: Build a dependency graph of learning outcomes across all three levels (L3, L4, L5) to detect orphaned outcomes, circular dependencies, or missing prerequisites. Visualize competency chains as interactive graphs.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_competency_chains.py parses all 20 CoCu learning outcome matrices, builds directed graph where nodes are outcomes and edges represent prerequisite relationships (extracted from outcome descriptions or manually specified in scripts/data/competency-map.json); detects cycles and orphaned nodes

Generates output/competency-graph.json in graph format (nodes, edges, metadata) and output/competency-chains.html with D3.js interactive visualization showing L3→L4→L5 pathways; highlights orphaned outcomes in red, cycles in orange
Exit code 0 if graph is valid (no cycles, no orphans); exit code 1 if issues found; includes output/remediation-paths.json with suggested fixes (e.g., 'Link L3 outcome 2.3 to L4 outcome 1.5')

stories.title: Generate Instructor Facilitation Schedule with Pacing & Bloom's Progression
stories.description: Create a detailed facilitation guide for instructors that breaks down each CoCu into 50-minute teaching sessions with timing budgets, activity sequencing, and Bloom's cognitive progression validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_facilitation_schedule.py reads all CoCu contact hour distributions, segments into 50-minute sessions, outputs Excel workbook with sheets per-CoCu: columns (Session#, Activity, Duration_Minutes, Bloom_Level, Knowledge_Mins, Performance_Mins, Learning_Outcome_ID, Instructor_Notes)

Validates total contact hours per CoCu (L3 must equal 1200, L4/L5 per COURSE ref); exit code 1 if mismatch; ensures Bloom's levels progress from Remember→Create within each session; gaps flagged in output/schedule-validation-report.txt

Includes --generate-timing-templates flag to create output/session-timing-templates.json with default activity durations (e.g., 'Introduction: 10 min', 'Demonstration: 20 min', 'Hands-on Practice: 15 min')

stories.title: Generate JPK Submission Manifest with Compliance Checksums & Readiness Score
stories.description: Bundle all 20 CoCu DOCX files into a submission-ready ZIP file with metadata, compliance checksums, and an automated readiness score (0-100) reflecting NOSS requirement pass rate.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_jpk_manifest.py reads all output/NOSS-IT-020-{3,4,5}-*.docx files, bundles into output/JPK-Submission.zip with directory structure (L3/, L4/, L5/, metadata/, checksums.txt); calculates MD5 + SHA256 checksums per file; creates metadata/manifest.json with {submission_id, date, total_cocu_count: 20, compliance_checks: {...}, readiness_score: 95}

Runs 15+ compliance checks (bilingual headers, contact hours, K/P split, learning outcome format, assessment criteria, references) per CoCu; stores pass/fail per check in manifest; calculates readiness_score = (checks_passed / 15 * 100); exit code 0 if readiness_score ≥85, 1 if <85

Generates output/JPK-READY-FOR-SUBMISSION.txt if score ≥90 and output/pre-submission-checklist.html with visual compliance dashboard (green for pass, red for fail) for final manual review before JPK upload

stories.title: Map Learning Outcomes to ISCO-08 Job Classifications & Malaysian Salary Data
stories.description: Align learning outcomes with real IT job market roles (ISCO-08 classifications) and Malaysian salary data. Validate curriculum relevance to actual industry demand and provide market context for students.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/map_job_alignment.py reads all learning outcome matrices, matches each outcome against ISCO-08 job classification database (scripts/data/isco-08-it-roles.csv: isco_code, job_title, description, required_skills) and Malaysian salary data (scripts/data/my-it-salaries-2025.csv: isco_code, job_title, avg_salary_myr, job_demand_score: 0-100)

Generates output/job-alignment-report.json with per-outcome mapping {outcome_text, mapped_isco_codes: [{isco_code: '2511.01', job_title: 'Systems Analyst', avg_salary_myr: 48000, demand_score: 85}], curriculum_relevance_score: 0-100}

Identifies skill gaps (outcomes not matching any ISCO role) and trending skills missing from curriculum; exit code 0 if ≥80% of outcomes map to active job roles; includes output/curriculum-market-alignment-gaps.json for product owner review
